definitions.explanation: A facility where convicted criminals serve their sentences. The formal term used in legal and official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刑務所|けいむしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{刑務所|けいむしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There's a man who just got out of prison.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刑務所|けいむしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{十年間|じゅうねんかん}⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The criminal ended up spending ten years in prison.

notes:
{刑務所|けいむしょ} is the standard formal term for a prison or penitentiary where convicted criminals serve their sentences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to go to prison
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get out of prison
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収容|しゅうよう}→収容：11800_shuuyou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be incarcerated
- {刑務所|けいむしょ}⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: prison life

RELATED FACILITIES:
- ⟦{拘置所|こうちしょ}→拘置所：30455_kouchisho⟧: detention center (for those awaiting trial)
- ⟦{留置場|りゅうちじょう}→留置場：30444_ryuuchijou⟧: police holding cell (short-term)
- {少年院|しょうねんいん}: juvenile detention facility

USAGE:
In casual speech, {刑務所|けいむしょ} may be shortened to ムショ. The slang expression ムショ{帰|がえ}り means someone who has done time in prison.
